bible.summary: Boss's office: tiled ceiling with light panels, framed certificate, shelf of binders, sales chart on the wall (line dips and shoots up), calendar, wall clock, desk at the back left with a computer, keyboard, desk phone, stack of folders, mug and a gold name plate, the boss's black office chair right of the desk (desk), window with blinds, water cooler and radiator under it, visitor's chair on a rug in the middle plane (visitor), potted plant. Variants: TV studio, police station, bank/government office.

variants.change: TV studio: dark studio with acoustic wall panels, a lighting truss with spotlights, a coloured LED backdrop with a big glowing circle ringed with bulbs and a news ticker, a red 'on air' lamp, studio lights on stands at both edges, cables on the glossy floor; a small curved desk with a microphone, papers and mugs in the middle (desk — standing presenter), the host's office chair left of it (host) with a prompter monitor, the guest's armchair right of it (guest).

Police station: cork board with wanted posters linked by red thread, clock, height chart on the wall for mugshots, handcuffs on a hook, the duty desk with a computer, a lamp, a radio, papers and a box of doughnuts at the back left with the officer's chair right of it (desk), a stool for the detainee in front of the desk (suspect, middle plane), a barred cell door on the right with a bunk and a small barred window inside and keys hanging by it (cell).

Bank / government office: marble wall, exchange-rate boards and a clock above, a counter across the whole back wall with three numbered glass teller windows (window-1 left, window-2 middle, window-3 right — clients stand there), stamps, a pen on a chain, a bell, forms and a small plant on the counter, queue rope on the left (queue), three waiting chairs in the middle plane on the right (wait-1…wait-3).

bible.prompt: boss office, big desk with computer and papers, office chair, potted plant, window with blinds
